what: TASKBOOK says Line A's headline 13.64/14.56/20.79 comes from 'frozen XLS-R features + a small probe trained on 290 labels, plus cell-prior correction'. Measured on the box, that route gives 24.65 pooled (k=10, BB+EB), and even an ORACLE cell prior only reaches 21.52 pooled on the p0cal scores. The 13.64 number is COMPARISON.md's line A: 290 labels train a head directly with NO prior correction (clips 13.05 / strict 13.64, AUC 0.94).
impact: S-F must be judged against the ADAPTATION route (BASE_F's B11 family), not only against the prior-correction family; otherwise the SOTA bar is ~9 EER points too low. The prior-correction family stays in BASE_F under its own name.
source: W4 on the box, 2026-10-14; wx2/docs/COMPARISON.md 0.0 line 42

item: B10_REDUCED is not a usable baseline
what: B10_REDUCED scored mean AUC 0.412 (< 0.5) over 50 draws: the head never trained. With a random initialisation the declared budget (5 epochs, lr <= 3e-5, AdamW) leaves the weights essentially at their random values, so the score is a random projection dominated by PC1 and comes out anti-correlated with the label. The full B10 (W13 on the GPU lane) is supposed to start from the backbone's own pretrained head, which this variant cannot do.
impact: Any 'we beat B10' statement made with these rows is vacuous. Either run the full B10 on the encoder, or report B10 as NOT_MEANINGFUL and keep it out of the S-F comparison.

item: W6 B6 detector was wired to Line A for every backbone
what: scripts/w6_baselines.py fed B6 the frozen Line A probe score (last_scores_p0cal_raw_s0.npy) regardless of --backbone, so B6 was identical on mms-1b and xls-r-2b (33.12 clips / 26.02 strict) and much worse than the true zero-shot (20.86). With --b6-zero backbone the same draws give xls-r-2b 18.92/19.94 and mms-1b 23.32/23.22.
impact: No S-F claim used B6 (it is not in BASE_F prime), but the stored B6 rows overstate its error by 6 to 14 points and hid the backbone dependence. The default stays lineA so old files remain reproducible; new runs should pass --b6-zero backbone.
source: w6b/w6a v3 reruns on the box, 2026-10-15 (results/w6_summary_v3_*_b6fix.csv)
